name: cell-relay
description: The in-path engine: interception, inspection, drift classification, repair. Rust; ships as a native binary and a WASM embed.

scripts.build: cargo build --workspace --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml && node node/scripts/build.mjs && python3 python/scripts/build.py --stage-only
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --all --check --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml && tsc --project wasm/tsconfig.json && tsc --project perf/tsconfig.json && tsc --project node/tsconfig.tests.json && tsc --project node/tsconfig.tooling.json && uv run --directory python --frozen mypy && tsc --project public-benchmark/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --project hosted/owner/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml && vitest run --config wasm/vitest.config.ts && node --test perf/tests/*.test.mjs && vitest run --config node/vitest.config.ts && node --test node/tests/*.test.mjs && uv run --directory python --frozen python -m unittest discover -s tests && node node/parity/run.mjs
scripts.build:renewal: wrangler deploy --config hosted/owner/control/wrangler.jsonc --dry-run && wrangler deploy --config hosted/owner/control/job.wrangler.jsonc --dry-run
